title: This grandma fought for a bill to allow happy hour at retirement homes
description: Anita LeBrun said she hoped to enjoy a drink with her friends, but it was also a matter of independence.

title: Trump shattered ethics norms. Will voters trust Democrats to fix them?
description: Democrats are making the case that now is the time to tackle anti-corruption reforms — to serve as a check on Donald Trump and to overhaul a system voters say is co-opted against their interests.

title: Survey finds most Americans believe corruption is a problem in politics
description: Voters indicate they're increasingly concerned about corruption in public office. A new survey indicates that concern spans the political spectrum.

title: Police vetted dubious allegation only after Buttigieg was separated from children
description: The Michigan attorney general’s office is investigating how the accusation that prompted the ex-Cabinet secretary's separation from his 4-year-old twins was handled.

title: Rand Paul releases Anthony Fauci's pandemic-era diary notes. Here's what they tell us
description: Sen. Rand Paul has released a tranche of Dr. Anthony Fauci's diary entries from the COVID-19 pandemic. Fauci is set to appear before a Senate committee Wednesday on the origins of the coronavirus.

title: Platner energized Maine's Democrats. Jackson's challenge will be to keep them engaged
description: Democrats have a new candidate for U.S. Senate in Maine: Troy Jackson. In one of the country's most closely-watched races, he'll have less than 100 days to make his case.

title: Inside Joe Manchin's new quest to elect more Independents to Congress
description: The former West Virginia senator was a lifelong Democrat before deciding to register as an independent two years ago. He now wants to create similar pathways for other politicians in both parties.

title: Deadly U.S. boat strikes have failed to curb cocaine supply, Pentagon and DEA officials say
description: The president says Operation Southern Spear has virtually ended drug trafficking by sea. Pentagon and DEA analysts have concluded otherwise.

title: With less than 100 days left until Election Day, how the midterms are shaping up
description: There are now fewer than 100 days until Election Day in November. Here's how NPR's Mara Liasson sees the midterm campaign shaping up.

title: In Memphis, an 'anti-crime' task force quietly turned into an ICE crackdown
description: The influx of federal agents into the city last fall led to widespread immigration arrests – a majority without criminal convictions. President Trump has said he wants to replicate it elsewhere.

title: Kalshi attacks a Wisconsin law banning election bets as 'voter suppression'
description: The spat between the leading prediction market company and a key battleground state could be a glimpse into the next major fight between states and the fast-growing industry.

title: Maine Democrats pick Troy Jackson to replace Graham Platner in Senate race
description: In Maine's U.S. Senate race, state Democrats have nominated Troy Jackson to replace the scandal-plagued candidate Graham Platner.

title: With just a few primary elections to go, the competitive Senate map keeps shifting
description: For Democrats to take control of the U.S. Senate, they have to flip four seats currently held by Republicans. Republicans, meanwhile, are playing defense and pickup opportunities are harder to find.

title: Republicans see ‘scary’ lack of enthusiasm among core voters ahead of midterms
description: Pollsters and GOP groups are raising the alarm about an unmotivated base in an election year that would be tough no matter what, given the president’s low approval.
